_comment: Facts + choices for scripts/standardize_vehicle.py: POLYGON Battle Royale SM_Veh_Truck_01 -> vehicles.json `jeep` (the type id stays, the model is a six-wheeled cargo truck at real size, no gun). Positions in the SOURCE frame (faces +Z; measured, docs/research/vehicle-models-facts.md). Wheels: the Scud's pattern, l = the vehicle's left (-x in the game frame; the pack's _fl/_rl are +x), the number counts the axles from the front; only axle 1 steers. The pack names its third right wheel `_rr_03` (a naming slip; the node name is what the GLB has). Seats: the cab bench, feet = cushion top (y 1.88) - 0.23 like the car, eye 1.0 above the feet (2.65, 0.17 under the roof lining). Lamps from the atlas texels: round headlights (x +-0.896, y 1.36, r 0.095) and red tail lamps (x +-0.914, y 1.28, 0.35 x 0.12) read from the UVs of the body mesh. `tow_hitch`: on the centre line 0.13 m behind the bed tail (the box's half_length + 0.12 at least, so a trailer starts clear of the footprint), at the rocket cart's eye height 0.62 (a bed this high leaves the chassis tail free under it).
name: Cargo truck (standardized SM_Veh_Truck_01)
